notes.title: Now The Glory Dungeon Raider has officially has the Thai language Localization
notes.content: [p][b]Event Description:[/b][/p][p]I am thrilled to announce that [i]The Glory Dungeon Raider[/i] now officially supports the Thai language! This long-awaited localization update allows our Thai-speaking adventurers to fully immerse themselves in the world of all in their native language.[/p][p]From in-game dialogues and tutorials to item descriptions and menus, every element has been carefully translated and localized to provide the best possible experience for our Thai community. Whether you're a new player or a returning raider, now is the perfect time to dive into the game and enjoy a more accessible and immersive journey.[/p][p]To celebrate this milestone, join me in making this a legendary adventure![/p][p]Let the journey begin — now in Thai! 🇹🇭[/p]

notes.title: The Glory Dungeon Raider has made his own art asset!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Dungeon Raiders![/p][p]I’ve got something special to share—[b]The Glory Dungeon Raider has taken matters into his own hands... literally![/b] For the first time, our fearless pixelated hero has crafted his [b]very own art asset[/b] and added it to the game![/p][p]It’s quirky, it’s bold, and it’s full of that classic dungeon-diving spirit you’ve come to love. This marks the beginning of more personality-driven content, straight from the heart of the dungeon.[/p][p]👀 Jump into the game and see if you can spot it!
💬 Let us know what you think in the comments—should the Raider keep creating?[/p][p]Stay glorious,
—HappyPaphy[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45492051/ec1547d8c6627d5d51860bac0087441420bff077.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 The Glory Dungeon Raider Demo Free Update! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey Dungeon Raiders!

We're excited to announce a free update for the demo version of The Glory Dungeon Raider! Here’s what’s new:

New Feature: Kick Monster by Rolling
Experience a dynamic new way to defeat your foes—roll and kick monsters away! Master the technique and add a fun twist to your combat strategy.

3-Stage Story Mode
Dive into a brand new story mode featuring three exciting stages. Explore new environments, uncover secrets, and challenge yourself in fresh scenarios—all available for free!

Bug Fixes & Improvements
We’ve squashed some bugs and polished the demo to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Update your demo now and let us know what you think! Your feedback is invaluable in helping us make The Glory Dungeon Raider even more epic.

Happy raiding! ⚔️🔥

notes.title: 📢 The Glory Dungeon Raider Story Mode is now developing 🎉
notes.content:
📢 Story Mode is Coming to The Glory Dungeon Raider! 🎉
Hello, Raiders! ⚔️

We’ve got some exciting news—The Glory Dungeon Raider is about to get even bigger and better with the upcoming Story Mode!

📝 What to Expect?
🔥 A gripping narrative—Uncover the dungeon's secrets and your character’s past.
🎭 Dynamic dialogues—Engaging storytelling with interactive elements.

This is just the beginning, and I can’t wait to share more details soon. Stay tuned for sneak peeks and updates!

💬 Let us know—What do you hope to see in Story Mode? Drop your thoughts in the comments!

🚀 Stay sharp, and get ready to raid like never before!

Let me know if you want to tweak the tone or add any extra details! 🚀
